moments.title: Tawas Point Light
moments.text: The sand kept building the point out into the lake until the first light stood too far inland to be seen, so this 70-foot tower replaced it in 1877.

moments.title: Alpena and Thunder Bay
moments.text: Offshore lies the first national marine sanctuary on the Great Lakes, kept for its shipwrecks, from wooden side-wheel steamers to steel-hulled ones.

moments.title: Old Presque Isle Light
moments.text: Built in 1840 and replaced after 1867 by a much taller tower two miles north, it is said to be haunted by a former caretaker who comes back to light the lamp.
